apps.name: DeckCraft (ACowork)
apps.summary: Presentations: slides, masters, shapes, tables and charts; opens and saves PowerPoint (.pptx).
apps.readme_md:
# DeckCraft (ACowork)

Presentations in ACowork: slides, masters and layouts, shapes, tables and charts, themes and text formatting. Opens and saves PowerPoint (`.pptx`, reads `.ppt` / `.potx`), exports PDF — in a hosted canvas agents can edit over MCP.

## Features

- Slide editor with masters/layouts, themes, guides and pasteboard overflow.
- Shapes, tables, charts and pictures; per-run text formatting and font fallback.
- PowerPoint round-trip (`.pptx` save is the default), PDF export, slide renders.
- Presenter view and slide sorter for review passes.

## Working with agents in ACowork

Installing the app adds it to the Desktop nav and registers its MCP tools with
the Gateway. Every agent session gets a headless document session **confined to
the workspace it is acting on**: open, inspect and edit files through tools, and
render a page or slide back as an image the agent can look at and attach to chat.
Edits land in the same workspace file the hosted UI shows, and the app's Save
writes back to it — so you and the agent edit one document, not two copies.

Typical loop: drop a file into the workspace (or attach it in chat), ask the agent
to change it, watch the result in the hosted UI, keep or refine it by hand.
- `document`, `go_to_slide`, `add_shape`, `set_text`, `insert_chart`, `export`.
- `render_slide` / `screenshot` return the slide as an image so the agent can see
  what it built; `run_command` / `commands` / `list_commands` expose the rest.

Ask e.g. *"turn page 3 into two columns with a chart"* or *"apply the brand theme
to every slide and export a PDF"*. Workspace `.pptx` / `.deckcraft` files open in
the hosted UI; Save writes back to the same file.

## License

Hosted adaptation of upstream DeckCraft, used under its MIT OR Apache-2.0 license. Links: [package repo](https://github.com/acowork/deckcraft-app) ·
[upstream](https://github.com/storytold/deckcraft) · [release](https://github.com/acowork/deckcraft-app/releases).

Files stay on this machine; nothing leaves it unless you share a file. Unsigned
packages need `apps.allow_unsigned = true` or `dev_mode` until a signed Release exists.

# FigCraft (ACowork)

Interface design and prototyping in ACowork: frames, auto layout, components and variants, vectors, styles, variables and interactive prototypes — edited in a hosted canvas and drivable by agents over MCP.

## Features

- Frames and auto layout for responsive screens; components with variants and overrides.
- Vector editing, fills/strokes/effects, shared styles and design variables.
- Prototypes with interactions; export PNG / JPEG / WebP / SVG / PDF.
- Inspect and drive the live UI: `ui.inspect`, `ui.pointer`, `ui.key`, `ui.type`.

## Working with agents in ACowork

Installing the app adds it to the Desktop nav and registers its MCP tools with
the Gateway. Every agent session gets a headless document session **confined to
the workspace it is acting on**: open, inspect and edit files through tools, and
render a page or slide back as an image the agent can look at and attach to chat.
Edits land in the same workspace file the hosted UI shows, and the app's Save
writes back to it — so you and the agent edit one document, not two copies.

Typical loop: drop a file into the workspace (or attach it in chat), ask the agent
to change it, watch the result in the hosted UI, keep or refine it by hand.
- `document.inspect`, `node.create` / `node.get` / `node.set`, `select.set`,
  `text.edit.begin` / `text.edit.end` for structural edits.
- `file.open` / `file.save` / `file.export`, `run_command` / `command.batch`,
  `screenshot` and `wait_for_changes` for look-and-verify loops.

Ask e.g. *"rebuild this screenshot as a login frame with auto layout"* or *"rename
every component variant to the new token names and export a PNG"*. Workspace
`.figcraft` files open in the hosted UI; renders write a sibling `.preview.png`

# GridCraft (ACowork)

Spreadsheets in ACowork: cells, a real formula engine, charts, formatting and sorting. Opens and saves Excel (`.xlsx`) in a hosted grid agents can compute on over MCP.

## Features

- Formula engine with the common Excel function set and live recalculation.
- Range formatting, number formats, sort and filter; charts from ranges.
- Multiple sheets, cell pictures and floating objects.
- Excel round-trip (`.xlsx` default save).

## Working with agents in ACowork

Installing the app adds it to the Desktop nav and registers its MCP tools with
the Gateway. Every agent session gets a headless document session **confined to
the workspace it is acting on**: open, inspect and edit files through tools, and
render a page or slide back as an image the agent can look at and attach to chat.
Edits land in the same workspace file the hosted UI shows, and the app's Save
writes back to it — so you and the agent edit one document, not two copies.

Typical loop: drop a file into the workspace (or attach it in chat), ask the agent
to change it, watch the result in the hosted UI, keep or refine it by hand.
- `get_cell` / `set_cell`, `evaluate_formula`, `format_range`, `sort_range`,
  `insert_chart`, plus `commands` for everything else.
- The agent reads and writes the same workbook the UI shows; formulas are
  evaluated by the engine, not guessed by the model.

Ask e.g. *"read sales.xlsx, add monthly totals and a column chart"* or *"clean the

# PdfCraft (ACowork)

PDF in ACowork: read, annotate, fill and sign forms, redact, OCR, reorganize and export — a full PDF workbench in a hosted canvas agents can drive over MCP.

## Features

- Viewing, annotations and comments; form filling and signatures.
- Redaction, OCR for scanned pages, accessibility and preflight checks.
- Organize: split, combine, reorder, bookmarks, Bates numbering, optimize.
- Export text, images, data and Office formats from PDF content.

## Working with agents in ACowork

Installing the app adds it to the Desktop nav and registers its MCP tools with
the Gateway. Every agent session gets a headless document session **confined to
the workspace it is acting on**: open, inspect and edit files through tools, and
render a page or slide back as an image the agent can look at and attach to chat.

- `doc_open` / `doc_inspect` / `doc_info` / `doc_save`, `doc_split` / `doc_combine` /

- `command_run` / `command_batch` / `command_list` for the long tail (annotations,

Vector illustration in ACowork: paths, brushes and effects with SVG as the native format. Imports AI / EPS / CDR / PDF artwork, exports SVG / PDF / PNG — in a hosted canvas agents can edit over MCP.

## Features

- Bezier path editing, brushes, live effects and boolean path operations.
- SVG-native document model; imports AI, EPS, CDR, PDF and metafiles.
- Export SVG, PDF and raster (PNG) at chosen sizes; image tracing.
- Undo history and format-aware save options.

## Working with agents in ACowork

Installing the app adds it to the Desktop nav and registers its MCP tools with

- `document` / `doc_inspect`, `run_command` / `commands` / `list_commands`,
  `save_file`, `undo`, `formats`.
- The agent edits paths and styles structurally, then renders to check the result
  before saving.

Ask e.g. *"recolor logo.svg to the brand blue and export a 512px PNG"* or *"trace
